deviations: CLAUDE.md section 1 specifies Python 3.11; this build runs Python 3.13.5, because 3.11 is not installed on this workstation and every pinned dependency publishes wheels for 3.13.

torch 2.13.0+cpu is a CPU build, so this workstation has no CUDA device. Model training was performed on a separate CUDA 12.8 workstation; checkpoint SHA-256 values are recorded in the examination manifest.
